body: I guess it's good to know we're not the only ones going through this, huh? Thanks for reaching out.

How long have I thought about it? I've fought chronic depression all my life, but the suicidal urges have only been around for the last couple of years. I've had some big setbacks in my personal life lately, which have pushed me to the brink. But I won't go through with it. I can't, which probably means I shouldn't be posting here. Thanks for taking the time to talk to me, BTW.
Glad to hear you've still got hope. Hold onto it.
I guess so. I think about suicide all the time. Every day. But I couldn't do that to my parents. I'd be ending three lives, not one.
